newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Tamil rebels say will target ships.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Tamil rebels say will target ships.

text.p: Tamil Tiger separatists warned on Tuesday they would attack ships in the seas off northern Jaffna peninsula because they carried supplies to the Sri Lankan military.
"Under these conditions the LTTE has no option but to regard these military-servicing Sri Lankan vessels as legitimate military targets," the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam said in a statement.
The statement, issued from the London office of LTTE, said that although the Sri Lankan government claimed it was feeding the people of Jaffna, it was really equipping its army in the peninsula.
Sri Lanka is forced to transport all supplies to Jaffna by sea or air as there is no road linking the peninsula with the rest of the island.

"The LTTE is not prepared to compromise the security of the Tamil people and will, therefore, do its utmost to prevent the traffic of items which do nothing other than strengthen Sri Lanka's military capability," the statement said.
The LTTE rebels, who are fighting for a separate homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east, have attacked two ships in recent weeks.
